comment: Deterministic forbidden-claim phrases for buyer-safe proof-packet markdown/text artifacts. Companion linter: ArchLucid.Cli.Commands.ProofPacketClaimLinter. Cross-link: docs/go-to-market/CLAIM_READINESS_STATUS.md#proof-language-claim-audit-static-buyer-docs.

forbiddenClaims.reason: ROI and savings figures must use RoiMetricSourceKind labels — outcomes cannot be guaranteed.
forbiddenClaims.suggestedSafeWording: Use illustrative, extractor-backed, or review-backed ROI with source labels and limitations.md caveats.

forbiddenClaims.reason: ROI outcomes cannot be guaranteed for buyer-facing proof packets.
forbiddenClaims.suggestedSafeWording: Label ROI as illustrative or extractor-backed and cite roi-metric-sources.md.

forbiddenClaims.reason: Cost savings cannot be guaranteed without customer-provided evidence labels.
forbiddenClaims.suggestedSafeWording: Use CustomerProvided or BenchmarkAssumption source kinds with explicit caveats.

forbiddenClaims.reason: ArchLucid publishes self-assessed SOC posture — CPA attestation is deferred (TB-135).
forbiddenClaims.suggestedSafeWording: Say self-assessed SOC readiness or roadmap to CPA attestation per trust-center.md.

forbiddenClaims.reason: Third-party pen-test publication is deferred (TB-136); owner-conducted testing is not a buyer certification claim.
forbiddenClaims.suggestedSafeWording: Reference self-assessed security posture or roadmap for third-party pen test.

forbiddenClaims.reason: Third-party pen-test publication is deferred (TB-136); owner-conducted testing is not a buyer certification claim.
forbiddenClaims.suggestedSafeWording: Reference self-assessed security posture or roadmap for third-party pen test.

forbiddenClaims.reason: Production SLA attainment is not evidenced in proof-packet artifacts.
forbiddenClaims.suggestedSafeWording: Reference pilot-scope reliability evidence or defer SLA claims to contract terms.

forbiddenClaims.reason: Execution mode varies (Real / Simulator / Fallback / Mixed) and must be labeled honestly.
forbiddenClaims.suggestedSafeWording: Cite structuralExecutionMode and limitations.md PilotStrict caveats.

forbiddenClaims.reason: Execution mode varies and must be labeled honestly on sponsor-facing artifacts.
forbiddenClaims.suggestedSafeWording: Cite structuralExecutionMode from environment.json and limitations.md.
